title: Rav Shmuel bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Rav Papa, as in [Nazir 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.51b.3), where he raised a difficulty against Rav Papa.
And in [Menachot 34a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.34a.7) and [Chullin 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.91a.16) before Rav Papa he transmitted a teaching in Rava bar Ulla’s name.
And in [Yoma 37a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.37a.11) the text reads: "Rav Shmuel bar Papa explained it before Rav Ada"; it should read Rav Shmuel bar Acha before Rav Papa, as in Dikdukei Soferim.

In Bava Metzia 46 and [Bava Batra 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.77b.3) and [150b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.150b.11), Rav Papa assigned the money to Rav Shmuel bar Acha. When Shmuel returned, Rav Papa went out to meet him as far as Torkh.
Hyman considers the reading Rav Shmuel bar Abba in [Bava Kamma 104b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.104b.4) a mistake.
And likewise he is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 99a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.99a.10) resolving the words of Rav Sheshet.[^3]

notes.text: The supplied place-name תורך is retained as Torkh; the checked Bava Batra reads תווך, Tavakh. Hyman’s corrections to the Shmuel/Acha/Papa chain remain attributed.

The inspected Bava Batra 77b directly names Shmuel bar Acha as recipient of Rav Papa’s assigned money and reads Tavakh. Hyman’s Torkh and the exact Dikdukei Soferim corrections to the Papa/Acha/Abba chains remain distinct reported readings.

The linked Menachot and Chullin have Shmuel bar Acha transmit in Rava bar Ulla’s name before Rav Papa. Heilprin records both. Yoma reads Shmuel bar Papa before Rav Ada. Bava Batra says Tavakh and names bar Acha; Bava Kamma 104b says To’akh and names bar Abba. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3368&lang=en).
